name: Fixture digest
description: A declarative test fixture (mold_v0-137; scripts/mcp-prompts-test.ts): a workspace's notes and the slash commands that work with them, declared in pack.json mcp.prompts. Never shipped.

mcp.instructions: Fixture digest keeps a workspace's notes. Read them with fixture_digest_list_digest_notes.

prompts.name: weekly_notes
prompts.title: Weekly notes
prompts.description: A short summary of the week's notes.

prompts.name: explain_note
prompts.title: Explain a note
prompts.description: Read one note and explain it in plain words.
prompts.text:
Explain the note {key}.
1. Call fixture_digest_get_digest_notes { key: {key|json} }.
2. Say what it means in two sentences.

prompts.name: notes_report
prompts.title: Notes report
prompts.description: A report on the notes of one topic, or of a time window.

arguments.name: topic
arguments.description: Only this topic; omit for every topic

arguments.name: since
arguments.description: Only notes since this date (YYYY-MM-DD); overrides days

text: Call fixture_digest_list_digest_notes with {?since}{topic,since|json}{/since}{!since}{topic,days|json}{/since}{!topic} (then group the notes by topic){/topic}.
{?days}Cover the last {days} days.{/days}{!days}Cover the last 30 days.{/days} Literal braces stay as written: {} and { topic: ... } and {{topic}.
